name: brand-mark-source
body:
Source of the kalide mark [with user]. The user supplied the logo SVG below; nothing is recreated. It is split into `brand/logo_dark.svg` (dark-filled hexagon tile, for dark backgrounds / dark mode) and `brand/logo_light.svg` (light-filled hexagon tile, for light backgrounds).

(a) SUPPLIED SVG (verbatim):
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <path d="m317.49 380.58-41.57 24.1-.02 47.62 41.23 23.77 41.63-23.85-.18-47.79z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:#121419" transform="translate(-124.65 -359.05)"/>
  <path d="m359.53 404.05-48.34 24.62 48.55 25.41z" style="fill:#ff5a25;stroke-width:1;transform-origin:594.616028px 588.650024px" transform="translate(-124.65 -359.05)"/>
  <path d="m286.8 185.3-63.63-32.84-19.01-16.67" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;stroke:#e5e7e6;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%" transform="translate(-51.95 -88.98)"/>
  <path d="m204.8 182.7 18.18-30.52 21.96-39.3m-.85 93.33-20.86-53.94m21.86 53.2 16.24-33.81" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;stroke:#e5e7e6" transform="translate(-51.95 -88.98)"/>
  <path d="m238.95 159.75 21.73-10.78 26.25-13.87" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4;stroke:#e5e7e6;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%" transform="translate(-51.95 -88.98)"/>
  <path d="m245.18 112.16-41.57 23.91-.03 47.62 41.23 23.95 41.63-23.65-.17-47.8z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke:#e5e6e8;fill:none;transform-origin:576.872px 588.518px" transform="translate(-51.95 -88.98)"/>
  <path d="m317.49 380.58-41.57 24.1-.02 47.62 41.23 23.77 41.63-23.85-.18-47.79z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:#e6e7e6" transform="translate(-257.38 -359.45)"/>
  <path d="m359.53 404.05-48.34 24.62 48.55 25.41z" style="fill:#ff5a25;stroke-width:1;transform-origin:594.616028px 588.650024px" transform="translate(-257.38 -359.45)"/>
  <path d="m286.8 185.3-63.63-32.84-19.01-16.67" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;stroke:#121419" transform="translate(-184.68 -89.38)"/>
  <path d="m204.8 182.7 18.18-30.52 21.96-39.3m-.85 93.33-20.86-53.94m21.86 53.2 16.24-33.81" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;stroke:#121419" transform="translate(-184.68 -89.38)"/>
  <path d="m238.95 159.75 21.73-10.78 26.25-13.87" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;stroke:#121419" transform="translate(-184.68 -89.38)"/>
  <path d="m245.18 112.16-41.57 23.91-.03 47.62 41.23 23.95 41.63-23.65-.17-47.8z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:none;transform-origin:576.872px 588.518px;stroke:#121419" transform="translate(-184.68 -89.38)"/>
</svg>

(b) Split/crop recipe. The canvas is 512×512, but both tiles sit in its top-left ~240×120px.
- DARK tile → `brand/logo_dark.svg`: the first 6 `<path>` elements (transforms translate(-124.65 -359.05) / (-51.95 -88.98)). It spans roughly x 148.6–237.5, y 20.2–121.7 including stroke. Suggested square crop `viewBox="139.05 16.95 108 108"`.
- LIGHT tile → `brand/logo_light.svg`: the last 6 `<path>` elements (transforms translate(-257.38 -359.45) / (-184.68 -89.38)). Same geometry offset by −132.73px in x and −0.4px in y. Suggested crop `viewBox="6.32 16.55 108 108"`.
The implementer keeps the path data and transforms unchanged, sets the cropped square viewBox, applies the recolour map, drops the unused tile's paths, and visually centres the hexagon (the crops are guidance; verify from the path data).
Recolour map (the board palette is canonical): `#121419`→`#0F1115` (the void); `#e5e7e6`, `#e6e7e6`, `#e5e6e8`→`#F8F9FA` (the structure); `#ff5a25`→`#FF5722` (the enforcer). After recolouring, each file contains only these three colours.

(c) The `transform-origin`/`transform-box` style properties are inert here (only translate is applied) and may be kept or removed.

The mark was designed to stay legible down to 16px; no PNG exports are required for 0.5.0.
